IssuerRegistry.note: Issuers and borrowers are separate rolls. Reading borrowers out of the issuer list gave every admitted borrower the right to mint. Also holds approveMint, keyed by NoteFactory.mintHash.

NoteFactory.note: Issuer must be a registered issuer, borrower a registered borrower, and the exact parameters approved.
NoteFactory.verification: Unverified. OKLink's plugin endpoint rejects it — the factory embeds the note and vault creation bytecode, and the endpoint verifies the registry beside it without complaint. Retry, or verify through OKLink's web form.

MockUSDG.warning: TESTNET ONLY. Minting is unrestricted, so this token is worthless as money. On mainnet, point RepaymentVault at the real USDG instead.

SaleDesk.note: Charges 25 bps to each side of a primary sale. The buyer pays the price plus 25 bps, the seller receives it less 25 bps, and both legs go to the treasury in the same transaction. Rate and treasury are immutable.

demo.note_: Cleared with the database. Both rolls on this registry are empty and no note has been minted through this factory. Notes under the superseded factories remain on-chain and are no longer indexed.
